verdict.rationale: First-party docs show handoffs that let one agent delegate tasks to specialist agents, plus an 'agents as tools' pattern for subagent-style calls without a full handoff. Multiple agents can use different models or providers, and built-in tracing records handoffs across a workflow. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-agent orchestration, and documentation of parallel or crew-style coordination beyond handoffs and agents-as-tools.
